verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS remote-access product that stores session data and AI-generated session summaries, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge capabilities. The audit log and API (teamviewer-docs-3) and the AI note-taker (teamviewer-docs-12) are adjacent features and earn no credit toward user-controlled retention or deletion.
